transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... people keep telling me I'm not listening. My supervisor at the plant, my wife... they'll be talking right at me, and then I just... I realize I missed half of it. Then I have to ask them to repeat themselves. It's causing some issues, so... here I am.
Does this happen to you in all situations or just in certain places, like at work?

It's... everywhere, really. Work is where it's the most serious, I guess. I've had some formal warnings lately. Working on the line, if you're not paying attention, it's a safety problem. So... I'm worried I might lose my job over it. 

And at home... yeah, it happens there too. My wife and kids get pretty frustrated with me. They say I just end up disrupting their routines instead of actually helping things run smooth.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless, like you can't sit still?

Yeah... I suppose so. I don't really think about it much, but... if I'm sitting in a safety huddle at the plant, or at the dinner table, my leg is usually bouncing. Or my hands are just... messing with a pen, or my keys. The guys at work tell me I'm shaking the whole bench sometimes. So... yeah. I guess I don't sit real still.
Do you have trouble following through on instructions or finishing tasks?
Not really. I mean... if I actually catch what they want me to do, I do it. I get my work done. So... no, I wouldn't say I leave things half-finished.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?

Yeah... I guess so. Mostly at work, I just... kind of step in. Like, if I see a coworker doing their setup, I'll just reach in and fix it for them, or... tell them how to do it. I don't really wait for them to ask. It causes some arguments on the floor... guys get mad that I don't wait my turn. So... yeah.
Do you often blurting out answers before questions have been completed?

Yeah... sometimes. Like in our meetings, I'll just... answer before the supervisor is even done asking. Half the time I'm already talking before I realize I didn't let him get to the important part. So... yeah, I do that.
Do you have trouble waiting for your turn in lines or when speaking in a group?
No, not really. I mean... I wait. If there's a line, I stand in it. I don't... push past people or anything. It's just a line.
Do you often talk excessively, dominating conversations?
No... not really. I don't think so. I'm not much of a talker, really. I just... say what I need to say and get back to work.
Do you have trouble organizing your tasks or activities?
No... not really. At the plant, the work is just... there in front of me. You just do it. I don't really have to organize much of anything. So, no.
Do you often feel impatient or have difficulty engaging in activities that require sustained mental effort?

I don't know... not really. I don't really do a lot of sit-down, mental kind of stuff anyway. It's mostly just physical work on the floor. I just... put my head down and get through the shift. So, no.
Do you often intrude on others or interrupt their conversations in social settings, outside of work?

Outside of work? I don't really go out. It's mostly just work and home. But... I guess at the plant, sometimes. 

I'll just... cut into what a guy is doing. Like, if I see their setup is wrong, I just reach over and fix it, or tell them how to do it. I don't really wait to be asked. Or wait my turn, I guess. It causes some arguments on the floor sometimes. But... yeah. That's about it.
Do you often make careless mistakes in your work or other activities?

I don't know... maybe. I guess on the line... I kind of rush through the quality checks. Just trying to keep moving. 

I'll miss little things... like a wrong label, or a loose fitting. Nothing major, but... my supervisor has to keep pulling me aside about it. Says it happens too much. So... yeah, I guess.
Have you experienced significant difficulties with inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity since childhood?

Yeah... I guess so. Pretty much always been this way. 

Like... even before middle school, I remember teachers were always moving my seat around. Said I couldn't stay put. I'd just... call out the answers, or get in trouble for butting into what the other kids were working on. Just couldn't help it, I guess. So... yeah. It's not new.
Have your symptoms, such as not listening or interrupting others, caused you significant problems or distress in your daily life?

Yeah... I suppose so. 

It's, uh... it's gotten pretty serious at work. I've had formal warnings now. I just... worry I might actually lose my job over it. Or cause a safety problem on the line. 

And... at home... it's not great. My wife and kids get pretty frustrated with me. They say I just disrupt their routines instead of... you know, helping things run smoothly. So... yeah. It's an issue.
Have you experienced these difficulties with inattention and impulsivity consistently across most areas of your life, including work, home, and social situations?

I mean... I guess so. 

Like I just said, it's... it's an issue at work, and with the family. That's pretty much my whole life right there. I don't really... do much else. So... yeah. Everywhere, I guess.
Have you ever been diagnosed with any other mental health conditions?
No... I don't think so. Never really saw anyone for this kind of stuff before.
Do you often feel like you're daydreaming or your mind is elsewhere when you're supposed to be focused on something?
No... not really. I don't... I don't just space out or daydream. It's... it's not really like that for me.
Do you often forget things you're supposed to do, like appointments or tasks?
No... not really. I mean, I know when I have to be at work. I don't... I don't usually forget stuff like that. So... no.
Have your symptoms caused problems in your relationships with friends or made it hard for you to make friends?

Friends? I don't... I don't really know about friends. It's mostly... it's work and home that are the real problem. 

At work, it's... well, it's gotten pretty serious. I've had some formal warnings. I just... I worry I'm gonna lose my job, or... or cause a safety problem on the line. 

And at home... my wife and kids just get frustrated with me. I guess I... I disrupt their routines a lot, instead of helping things run smoothly. So... yeah. It causes issues.
